input.body: We are writing to ask for a review of the $24.30 deduction taken for order UE-9a31 on 2026-11-05, which was given the reason "missing item" (Honey Drizzle). The order ticket for UE-9a31 lists Honey Drizzle, which shows the item was part of the order as placed, although the ticket alone does not show how the order was packed. Our records show the order was ready at 12:28 and was picked up by the courier at 12:33, a handoff 5 minutes after it was ready [UE-9a31:pickup_handoff]. Based on this, we do not have evidence that the order left the restaurant incomplete. We respectfully request that the deduction be reviewed and, if the findings support it, reversed. Please let us know if any further information would help.
